verses.en: Verily, thus saith the Lord unto you who have assembled yourselves together to receive his will concerning you:
verses.sm: E moni, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii ia te outou o e ua faapotopoto faatasi outou lava ia maua lona finagalo e faatatau ia te outou:

verses.en: Behold, this is pleasing unto your Lord, and the angels rejoice over you; the alms of your prayers have come up into the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth, and are recorded in the book of the names of the sanctified, even them of the celestial world.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua logomalie lenei mea i lo outou Alii, ma ua olioli agelu i o outou luga; ua oo mai taulaga o a outou talosaga i luga i fofoga o le Alii o Sapaota, ma ua tusifaamaumauina i le tusi o igoa o e ua faapaiaina, i latou ia o le lalolagi selesitila.

verses.en: Wherefore, I now send upon you another Comforter, even upon you my friends, that it may abide in your hearts, even the Holy Spirit of promise; which other Comforter is the same that I promised unto my disciples, as is recorded in the testimony of John.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, Ou te auina atu nei i o outou luga, i luga lava lea o outou o a’u uo, se isi Fesoasoani, o le Agaga Paia lea o le folafolaga, ia mau i o outou loto; o le isi Fesoasoani lea, o lea lava e tasi na Ou folafola atu i o’u soo, e pei ona tusifaamaumauina i le molimau a Ioane.

verses.en: This Comforter is the promise which I give unto you of eternal life, even the glory of the celestial kingdom;
verses.sm: O lenei Fesoasoani o le folafolaga lea o le ola e faavavau Ou te tuu atu ia te outou, o le mamalu lava lea o le malo selesitila;

verses.en: Which glory is that of the church of the Firstborn, even of God, the holiest of all, through Jesus Christ his Son—
verses.sm: O le mamalu lena o le ekalesia a le Ulumatua, o le mamalu lava lea o le Atua, o lē ua silisili ona paia i tagata uma, e ala ia Iesu Keriso lona Alo—

verses.en: He that ascended up on high, as also he descended below all things, in that he comprehended all things, that he might be in all and through all things, the light of truth;
verses.sm: O Ia o lē na afio a’e i lugā, e pei foi ona afio ifo o ia i lalo o mea uma, lea na malamalama ai o ia i mea uma, ina ia mafai ona i ai o ia, o le malamalama o le upumoni, i mea uma ma ala atu i mea uma;

verses.en: Which truth shineth. This is the light of Christ. As also he is in the sun, and the light of the sun, and the power thereof by which it was made.
verses.sm: O le upumoni lea ua susulu atu. O le malamalama lea o Keriso. E pei foi ona i ai o ia i le la, ma le susulu o le la, ma le mana o i ai, lea na faia ai.

verses.en: As also he is in the moon, and is the light of the moon, and the power thereof by which it was made;
verses.sm: E pei foi ona i ai o ia i le masina, ma o le susulu o ia o le masina, ma le mana o i ai, lea na faia ai;

verses.en: As also the light of the stars, and the power thereof by which they were made;
verses.sm: E pei foi o le susulu o fetu, ma le mana o i ai, lea na faia ai;

verses.en: And the earth also, and the power thereof, even the earth upon which you stand.
verses.sm: Ma le lalolagi foi, le lalolagi lava lea o loo outou tutu ai, ma le mana o i ai.

verses.en: And the light which shineth, which giveth you light, is through him who enlighteneth your eyes, which is the same light that quickeneth your understandings;
verses.sm: Ma o le sulu lea o loo susulu atu, lea ua tuu atu ai ia te outou le malamalama, ua ala mai ia te ia o lē ua faamalamalamaina o outou mata, o le malamalama lava lea e tasi ua faapupulaina o outou malamalamaaga;

verses.en: Which light proceedeth forth from the presence of God to fill the immensity of space—
verses.sm: O le malamalama lea ua susulu atu mai luma o le Atua e faatumulia ai le loaloa o le vateatea—

verses.en: The light which is in all things, which giveth life to all things, which is the law by which all things are governed, even the power of God who sitteth upon his throne, who is in the bosom of eternity, who is in the midst of all things.
verses.sm: O le malamalama lea ua i totonu o mea uma, lea ua tuuina le ola i mea uma, o le tulafono lea ua pulea ai mea uma, o le mana lava lea o le Atua o lē o loo afio i luga o lona nofoalii, o lē o loo i le loto o le faavavau, o lē ua i ai i le totonugalemu o mea uma.

verses.en: Now, verily I say unto you, that through the redemption which is made for you is brought to pass the resurrection from the dead.
verses.sm: O lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le togiola ua faia mo outou ua ala mai ai le faataunuuina o le toetutu mai le oti.

verses.en: And the spirit and the body are the soul of man.
verses.sm: Ma o le agaga ma le tino o le tagata lea.

verses.en: And the resurrection from the dead is the redemption of the soul.
verses.sm: Ma o le toetu mai le oti o le togiolaina lea o le tagata.

verses.en: And the redemption of the soul is through him that quickeneth all things, in whose bosom it is decreed that the poor and the meek of the earth shall inherit it.
verses.sm: Ma o le togiolaina o le tagata ua ala mai lea i lē na te faaolaina mea uma, o lē ua ia folafola i lona loto o le a fai le lalolagi ma tofi o e matitiva ma e agamalu.

verses.en: Therefore, it must needs be sanctified from all unrighteousness, that it may be prepared for the celestial glory;
verses.sm: O lea, e tatau ai ona faapaia le lalolagi mai amioletonu uma, ina ia saunia mo le mamalu selesitila;

verses.en: For after it hath filled the measure of its creation, it shall be crowned with glory, even with the presence of God the Father;
verses.sm: Auā a uma ona faataunuu e le lalolagi le faamoemoe o lona foafoaga, o le a faapaleina i le mamalu, i le afio ai lava lea o le Atua le Tamā:

verses.en: That bodies who are of the celestial kingdom may possess it forever and ever; for, for this intent was it made and created, and for this intent are they sanctified.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai e tino o e o le malo selesitila ona mauaina e faavavau faavavau lava; auā, o le faamoemoe lea na faia ma foafoa ai le lalolagi, ma o le faamoemoe lea ua faapaiaina ai i latou.

verses.en: And they who are not sanctified through the law which I have given unto you, even the law of Christ, must inherit another kingdom, even that of a terrestrial kingdom, or that of a telestial kingdom.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e e lē faapaiaina i le tulafono lea na Ou tuu atu ia te outou, le tulafono lava lea a Keriso, e ao ina mautofi i se isi malo, po o lena o se malo terasitila, po o se malo telesitila.

verses.en: For he who is not able to abide the law of a celestial kingdom cannot abide a celestial glory.
verses.sm: Ona o ia o lē e lē mafai ona ola i le tulafono o se malo selesitila e lē mafai ona ia gafatia se mamalu selesitila.

verses.en: And he who cannot abide the law of a terrestrial kingdom cannot abide a terrestrial glory.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e lē mafai ona ola i le tulafono o se malo terasitila e lē mafai ona ia gafatia se mamalu terasitila.

verses.en: And he who cannot abide the law of a telestial kingdom cannot abide a telestial glory; therefore he is not meet for a kingdom of glory. Therefore he must abide a kingdom which is not a kingdom of glory.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e lē mafai ona ola i le tulafono o se malo telesitila e lē mafai ona ia gafatia se mamalu telesitila; o lea ua lē agavaa o ia mo se malo o le mamalu. O lea e ao ai ina mau o ia i se malo e lē o se malo o le mamalu.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, the earth abideth the law of a celestial kingdom, for it filleth the measure of its creation, and transgresseth not the law—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua i ai le lalolagi i le tulafono o se malo selesitila, ona ua faataunuu ai le faamoemoega o lona foafoaga, ma lē solia ai le tulafono—

verses.en: Wherefore, it shall be sanctified; yea, notwithstanding it shall die, it shall be quickened again, and shall abide the power by which it is quickened, and the righteous shall inherit it.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le a faapaiaina le lalolagi; ioe, e ui o le a mate, o le a toe faaolaina, ma o le a gafatia le mana lea e faaola ai, ma o le a fai ma tofi o e amiotonu.

verses.en: For notwithstanding they die, they also shall rise again, a spiritual body.
verses.sm: Auā e ui ina oti i latou, o le a latou toe tutu mai foi, o se tino faaleagaga.

verses.en: They who are of a celestial spirit shall receive the same body which was a natural body; even ye shall receive your bodies, and your glory shall be that glory by which your bodies are quickened.
verses.sm: O i latou o e o se agaga selesitila o le a latou maua le tino lava e tasi sa o se tino natura; o le a outou maua lava o outou tino, ma o lo outou mamalu o le a o lena mamalu e faaola ai o outou tino.

verses.en: Ye who are quickened by a portion of the celestial glory shall then receive of the same, even a fulness.
verses.sm: O outou o e e faaolaina e se vaega o le mamalu selesitila o le a outou maua i lena taimi lea lava mamalu e tasi, o se atoatoaga lava.

verses.en: And they who are quickened by a portion of the terrestrial glory shall then receive of the same, even a fulness.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e e faaolaina e se vaega o le mamalu terasitila o le a latou maua i lena taimi lea lava mamalu e tasi, o se atoatoaga lava.

verses.en: And also they who are quickened by a portion of the telestial glory shall then receive of the same, even a fulness.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou foi o e e faaolaina e se vaega o le mamalu telesitila o le a latou maua i le taimi lena lea lava mamalu e tasi, o se atoatoaga lava.

verses.en: And they who remain shall also be quickened; nevertheless, they shall return again to their own place, to enjoy that which they are willing to receive, because they were not willing to enjoy that which they might have received.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e e totoe o le a faaolaina foi; ae ui i lea, o le a toe foi atu i latou i lo latou lava nofoaga, e olioli i mea ua latou loto e talia, aua sa latou lē loto e olioli i mea semanū latou te maua.

verses.en: For what doth it profit a man if a gift is bestowed upon him, and he receive not the gift? Behold, he rejoices not in that which is given unto him, neither rejoices in him who is the giver of the gift.
verses.sm: Auā se a le aoga i se tagata pe a tuu atu se meaalofa i ona luga, ae na te lē taliaina le meaalofa? Faauta, e lē olioli o ia i le mea ua tuuina atu ia te ia, pe olioli foi ia te ia o lē na tuuina mai le meaalofa.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, that which is governed by law is also preserved by law and perfected and sanctified by the same.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le mea ua pulea i le tulafono ua faasaoina foi i le tulafono ma ua faaatoatoa ma faapaiaina i lea lava tulafono e tasi.

verses.en: That which breaketh a law, and abideth not by law, but seeketh to become a law unto itself, and willeth to abide in sin, and altogether abideth in sin, cannot be sanctified by law, neither by mercy, justice, nor judgment. Therefore, they must remain filthy still.
verses.sm: O ia o lē e solia se tulafono, ma lē ola i le tulafono, ae saili e avea ma se tulafono ia te ia lava, ma loto e ola i le agasala, ma ola atoa i le agasala, e lē mafai ona faapaiaina i le tulafono, pe i le alofa mutimutivale, faamasinotonu, po o le faamasinoga. O lea, o le a tumau pea i latou i le eleelea.

verses.en: All kingdoms have a law given;
verses.sm: O malo uma ua i ai se tulafono ua tuuina atu i ai;

verses.en: And there are many kingdoms; for there is no space in the which there is no kingdom; and there is no kingdom in which there is no space, either a greater or a lesser kingdom.
verses.sm: Ma e tele malo ua i ai; ona ua leai se avanoa ua lē o i ai se malo; ma ua leai se malo ua lē o i ai se avanoa, pe o se malo tele po o se malo itiiti.

verses.en: And unto every kingdom is given a law; and unto every law there are certain bounds also and conditions.
verses.sm: Ma ua tuuina atu i malo taitasi se tulafono; ma ua i ai foi i tulafono taitasi ni tuaoi ma ni tuutuuga faapitoa.

verses.en: All beings who abide not in those conditions are not justified.
verses.sm: O tagata uma o e e lē ola i ia tuutuuga e lē ta’uamiotonuina.

verses.en: For intelligence cleaveth unto intelligence; wisdom receiveth wisdom; truth embraceth truth; virtue loveth virtue; light cleaveth unto light; mercy hath compassion on mercy and claimeth her own; justice continueth its course and claimeth its own; judgment goeth before the face of him who sitteth upon the throne and governeth and executeth all things.
verses.sm: Ona o le atamai e pipii i le atamai; o le poto e talia le poto; o le upu moni e fusia le upu moni; o le amiomamā e fiafia i le amiomamā; o le malamalama e pipii i le malamalama; o le alofa mutimutivale e agaalofa i le alofa mutimutivale ma aiā i ana lava; o le faamasinotonu e alu pea i lona ala ma aiā i ana lava; e alu atu le faamasinoga i luma o fofoga o ia o lē ua afio i luga o le nofoalii ma pulea ma faia mea uma.

verses.en: He comprehendeth all things, and all things are before him, and all things are round about him; and he is above all things, and in all things, and is through all things, and is round about all things; and all things are by him, and of him, even God, forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ua malamalama o ia i mea uma, ma ua i ai mea uma i ona luma, ma ua siomia o ia i mea uma; ma ua i ai o ia i luga o mea uma, ma i totonu o mea uma, ma i ai e ala atu i mea uma, ma ua faataamilo i mea uma; ma o mea uma ua ala mai ia te ia, ma e a ia, o le Atua lea, e faavavau faavavau lava.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, he hath given a law unto all things, by which they move in their times and their seasons;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua tuuina mai e ia se tulafono i mea uma, lea ua latou gaoioi ai i o latou taimi ma o latou tau;

verses.en: And their courses are fixed, even the courses of the heavens and the earth, which comprehend the earth and all the planets.
verses.sm: Ma o o latou ala ua faia tumau, e oo lava i ala o le lagi ma le lalolagi, lea ua aofia ai le lalolagi ma paneta uma.

verses.en: And they give light to each other in their times and in their seasons, in their minutes, in their hours, in their days, in their weeks, in their months, in their years—all these are one year with God, but not with man.
verses.sm: Ma latou te tuu atu le malamalama i le tasi i o latou taimi ma o latou tau, i o latou minute, i o latou itula, i o latou aso, i o latou vaiaso, i o latou masina, i o latou tausaga— o nei mea uma o se tausaga e tasi i le Atua, ae lē i le tagata.

verses.en: The earth rolls upon her wings, and the sun giveth his light by day, and the moon giveth her light by night, and the stars also give their light, as they roll upon their wings in their glory, in the midst of the power of God.
verses.sm: E taavale le lalolagi i luga o ona apaau, ma e tuu mai e le la lona malamalama i le ao, ma e tuu mai e le masina lona malamalama i le po, ma e tuu mai foi e fetu o latou malamalama, a’o taavavale i luga o o latou apaau i lo latou mamalu, i le lotolotoi o le mana o le Atua.

verses.en: Unto what shall I liken these kingdoms, that ye may understand?
verses.sm: O se a se mea Ou te faatusa i ai nei malo, ina ia mafai ona outou malamalama ai?

verses.en: Behold, all these are kingdoms, and any man who hath seen any or the least of these hath seen God moving in his majesty and power.
verses.sm: Faauta, o nei mea uma o malo, ma o soo se tagata ua vaai i soo se tasi po o le aupito itiiti o ia malo, ua vaai i le Atua o femaliua’i i lona mamalu ma lona mana.

verses.en: I say unto you, he hath seen him; nevertheless, he who came unto his own was not comprehended.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu ia te outou, sa vaai o ia ia te ia; ae ui i lea, o ia o lē na afio mai i ona lava, sa lē malamalama i ai.

verses.en: The light shineth in darkness, and the darkness comprehendeth it not; nevertheless, the day shall come when you shall comprehend even God, being quickened in him and by him.
verses.sm: Ua susulu atu le malamalama i le pouliuli, a ua lē malamalama i ai le pouliuli; ae ui i lea, e oo mai le aso o le a outou malamalama ai i le Atua lava, i le faaolaina o outou ia te ia, ma e ia.

verses.en: Then shall ye know that ye have seen me, that I am, and that I am the true light that is in you, and that you are in me; otherwise ye could not abound.
verses.sm: Ona outou iloa lea ua outou vaai ia te a’u, ua Ou i ai, ma o A’u lea o le malamalama moni ua i totonu ia te outou, ma ua outou i ai i totonu ia te a’u; a lē o lea e lē mafai ona outou uluuluola.

verses.en: Behold, I will liken these kingdoms unto a man having a field, and he sent forth his servants into the field to dig in the field.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le a Ou faatusaina ia malo i se tagata ua i ai se fanua, ma ua ia auina atu ana auauna i le fanua e eli i le fanua.

verses.en: And he said unto the first: Go ye and labor in the field, and in the first hour I will come unto you, and ye shall behold the joy of my countenance.
verses.sm: Ma ua fai atu o ia i lē ua muamua: Inā alu atu ia oe ma galue i le fanua, ma o le a ou alu atu ia te oe i le itula muamua, ma o le a e vaai i le olioli o o’u foliga.

verses.en: And he said unto the second: Go ye also into the field, and in the second hour I will visit you with the joy of my countenance.
verses.sm: Ma ua fai atu o ia i lē e lona lua: Inā alu atu ia foi oe i le fanua, ma o le a ou asiasi atu ia te oe i le itula lona lua ma o le a e vaai i le olioli o o’u foliga.

verses.en: And also unto the third, saying: I will visit you;
verses.sm: Ma i lē e lona tolu foi, ua fai atu i ai: O le a ou asiasi atu ia te oe;

verses.en: And unto the fourth, and so on unto the twelfth.
verses.sm: Ma i lē e lona fa, ma faapea lava e oo i lē e lona sefululua.

verses.en: And the lord of the field went unto the first in the first hour, and tarried with him all that hour, and he was made glad with the light of the countenance of his lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa alu atu le alii o le fanua i lē na muamua i le itula muamua, ma nonofo faatasi ma ia i le itula atoa lena, ma sa faafiafiaina o ia i le susulu o fofoga o lona alii.

verses.en: And then he withdrew from the first that he might visit the second also, and the third, and the fourth, and so on unto the twelfth.
verses.sm: Ma ona tuumuli ese ai lea o ia mai lē na muamua ina ia mafai e ia ona asiasi atu foi i lē e lona lua, ma lē e lona tolu, ma lē e lona fa, ma faapea lava e oo atu i lē e lona sefululua.

verses.en: And thus they all received the light of the countenance of their lord, every man in his hour, and in his time, and in his season—
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona latou maua uma le susulu o fofoga o lo latou alii, o tagata taitoatasi i lona itula, ma i lona taimi, ma i lona tau—

verses.en: Beginning at the first, and so on unto the last, and from the last unto the first, and from the first unto the last;
verses.sm: E amata mai i lē na muamua, ma faapea lava e oo atu i lē e mulimuli, ma mai lē e mulimuli e oo mai i lē na muamua, ma mai i lē na muamua e oo atu i lē e mulimuli;

verses.en: Every man in his own order, until his hour was finished, even according as his lord had commanded him, that his lord might be glorified in him, and he in his lord, that they all might be glorified.
verses.sm: O tagata taitoatasi i lona lava faasologa, seia uma lona itula, e pei lava ona sa poloaiina ai o ia e lona alii, ina ia faamamaluina lona alii ia te ia, ma ia i lona alii, ina ia mafai ona faamamaluina i latou uma.

verses.en: Therefore, unto this parable I will liken all these kingdoms, and the inhabitants thereof—every kingdom in its hour, and in its time, and in its season, even according to the decree which God hath made.
verses.sm: O lea, Ou te faatusaina nei malo uma i lenei faataoto, ma e o nonofo ai— o malo taitasi i lona itula, ma i lona taimi, ma i lona tau, e tusa lava ma le folafolaga na faia e le Atua.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, my friends, I leave these sayings with you to ponder in your hearts, with this commandment which I give unto you, that ye shall call upon me while I am near—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o a’u uo, Ou te tuu atu nei upu ia te outou tou te mafaufau i ai i o outou loto, faatasi ma le poloaiga lenei Ou te tuu atu ia te outou, ia outou valaau mai ia te a’u manū o Ou latalata atu—

verses.en: Draw near unto me and I will draw near unto you; seek me diligently and ye shall find me; ask, and ye shall receive; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.sm: Faalatalata mai ia te a’u ma o le a Ou faalatalata atu ai ia te outou; saili mai ia te a’u ma le filiga ma o le a outou maua ai a’u; ole mai, ma o le a outou maua ai; tu’itu’i mai, ma o le a tatala atu ai ia te outou.

verses.en: Whatsoever ye ask the Father in my name it shall be given unto you, that is expedient for you;
verses.sm: Soo se mea tou te ole atu ai i le Tamā i lo’u igoa ua tatau ai mo outou, o le a tuuina mai ia te outou;

verses.en: And if ye ask anything that is not expedient for you, it shall turn unto your condemnation.
verses.sm: Ma afai tou te ole atu mo se mea ua lē tatau ai mo outou, o le a liua mo lo outou ta’usalaga.

verses.en: Behold, that which you hear is as the voice of one crying in the wilderness—in the wilderness, because you cannot see him—my voice, because my voice is Spirit; my Spirit is truth; truth abideth and hath no end; and if it be in you it shall abound.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le mea ua outou faalogo mai i ai ua pei o le leo o lē ua alaga i le vao— i le vao, auā ua lē mafai ona outou vaai atu ia te ia— o lo’u leo, auā o lo’u leo o le Agaga lea; o lo’u Agaga o le upumoni lea; e tumau le upumoni ma ua leai sona iuga; ma afai e i ai i totonu o outou o le a uluola.

verses.en: And if your eye be single to my glory, your whole bodies shall be filled with light, and there shall be no darkness in you; and that body which is filled with light comprehendeth all things.
verses.sm: Ma afai e tau-tasi o outou mata i lo’u mamalu, o le a faatumulia o outou tino atoa i le malamalama, ma o le a leai se pouliuli e ia te outou; ma o lena tino ua faatumulia i le malamalama e malamalama i mea uma.

verses.en: Therefore, sanctify yourselves that your minds become single to God, and the days will come that you shall see him; for he will unveil his face unto you, and it shall be in his own time, and in his own way, and according to his own will.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou faapaia outou lava ina ia tau-tasi o outou mafaufau i le Atua, ma e oo mai aso o le a outou vaai ai ia te ia; ona o le a afe ese e ia le veli mai ona fofoga ia te outou, ma o le a faia lena mea i lona lava taimi, ma i lana lava ala, ma e tusa ai ma lona lava finagalo.

verses.en: Remember the great and last promise which I have made unto you; cast away your idle thoughts and your excess of laughter far from you.
verses.sm: Ia manatua le folafolaga tele ma le mulimuli lea na Ou fai atu ia te outou; ia lafo mamao ese mai ia te outou o mafaufauga lē aoga ma lo outou ’ata leoleoā.

verses.en: Tarry ye, tarry ye in this place, and call a solemn assembly, even of those who are the first laborers in this last kingdom.
verses.sm: Ia outou nonofo, ia outou nonofo i le nofoaga lenei, ma talo se faapotopotoga paia, e mo i latou lava o e ua muai galulue i le malo mulimuli lenei.

verses.en: And let those whom they have warned in their traveling call on the Lord, and ponder the warning in their hearts which they have received, for a little season.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia te i latou o e na latou lapata’iina ia latou malaga e valaau atu i le Alii, ma mafaufau i o latou loto i le lapataiga ua latou maua, mo se vaitau itiiti.

verses.en: Behold, and lo, I will take care of your flocks, and will raise up elders and send unto them.
verses.sm: Faauta, ma tagai, o le a Ou tausia a outou lafu, ma o le a Ou faatutuina a’e toeaina ma auina atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: Behold, I will hasten my work in its time.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le a Ou faanatinati la’u galuega i lona taimi.

verses.en: And I give unto you, who are the first laborers in this last kingdom, a commandment that you assemble yourselves together, and organize yourselves, and prepare yourselves, and sanctify yourselves; yea, purify your hearts, and cleanse your hands and your feet before me, that I may make you clean;
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu ia te outou, o e o tagata galulue muamua i le malo mulimuli lenei, se poloaiga ia outou faapotopoto faatasi outou lava, ma faatulaga outou lava, ma saunia outou lava, ma faapaia outou lava; ioe, ia faamamā o outou loto, ma faamamā o outou lima ma o outou vae i o’u luma, ina ia mafai ona Ou faamamāina outou;

verses.en: That I may testify unto your Father, and your God, and my God, that you are clean from the blood of this wicked generation; that I may fulfil this promise, this great and last promise, which I have made unto you, when I will.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona Ou molimau atu i lo outou Tamā, ma lo outou Atua, ma lo’u Atua, ua outou mamā mai le toto o lenei tupulaga amioleaga; ina ia mafai ona Ou faataunuuina lenei folafolaga, lenei folafolaga tele ma le mulimuli, lea na Ou fai atu ia te outou, pe a Ou loto i ai.

verses.en: Also, I give unto you a commandment that ye shall continue in prayer and fasting from this time forth.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga ia outou faaauau pea i le tatalo ma le anapogi mai le taimi nei ma le agai i luma.

verses.en: And I give unto you a commandment that you shall teach one another the doctrine of the kingdom.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga ia outou a’oa’o atu le tasi i le isi aoaoga faavae o le malo.

verses.en: Teach ye diligently and my grace shall attend you, that you may be instructed more perfectly in theory, in principle, in doctrine, in the law of the gospel, in all things that pertain unto the kingdom of God, that are expedient for you to understand;
verses.sm: Ia outou a’oa’o atu ma le filiga ma o le a i ai lo’u alofa tunoa ia te outou, ina ia mafai ona a’oa’oina atoatoa atili outou i teori, i mataupu faavae, i aoaoga faavae, i le tulafono o le talalelei, i mea uma tau i le malo o le Atua, ua tatau mo outou ona malamalama i ai;

verses.en: Of things both in heaven and in the earth, and under the earth; things which have been, things which are, things which must shortly come to pass; things which are at home, things which are abroad; the wars and the perplexities of the nations, and the judgments which are on the land; and a knowledge also of countries and of kingdoms—
verses.sm: O mea o i le lagi ma o i le lalolagi, ma o i lalo o le lalolagi; o mea sa i ai, o mea o i ai, o mea ua vave ona oo mai; o mea o loo i le atunuu, o mea o i isi atunuu; o taua ma faafatiatama’i o atunuu, ma faamasinoga o loo i luga o le laueleele; ma se malamalama foi i atunuu ma malo—

verses.en: That ye may be prepared in all things when I shall send you again to magnify the calling whereunto I have called you, and the mission with which I have commissioned you.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona outou saunia i mea uma pe a Ou toe auina atu outou e faalautele le valaauga lea ua Ou valaaulia i ai outou, ma le misiona lea ua Ou tofia ai outou.

verses.en: Behold, I sent you out to testify and warn the people, and it becometh every man who hath been warned to warn his neighbor.
verses.sm: Faauta, na Ou auina atu outou e molimau ma lapatai atu i tagata, ma ua tatau i tagata taitoatasi o e ua uma ona lapata’ia ona lapatai atu i lē la te tuaoi.

verses.en: Therefore, they are left without excuse, and their sins are upon their own heads.
verses.sm: O lea, e tuu ai i latou e aunoa ma se ’alofaga, ma ua i luga o o latou lava ulu a latou agasala.

verses.en: He that seeketh me early shall find me, and shall not be forsaken.
verses.sm: O ia o lē e saili vave mai ia te a’u o le a ia maua a’u, ma o le a lē tuulafoaiina.

verses.en: Therefore, tarry ye, and labor diligently, that you may be perfected in your ministry to go forth among the Gentiles for the last time, as many as the mouth of the Lord shall name, to bind up the law and seal up the testimony, and to prepare the saints for the hour of judgment which is to come;
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou nonofo ai, ma galulue ma le filiga, ina ia mafai ona faaatoatoaina outou i la outou auaunaga e o atu i totonu o Nuuese i le taimi mulimuli, e tusa ma le toatele e ta’u mai e le fofoga o le Alii, e fusifaamau le tulafono ma faamau le molimau, ma saunia le au paia mo le itula o le faamasinoga o le a oo mai;

verses.en: That their souls may escape the wrath of God, the desolation of abomination which awaits the wicked, both in this world and in the world to come. Verily, I say unto you, let those who are not the first elders continue in the vineyard until the mouth of the Lord shall call them, for their time is not yet come; their garments are not clean from the blood of this generation.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona sao o o latou agaga mai le toasa o le Atua, o le faatafunaga lea o mea inosia o loo faatali mai mo e amioleaga, i le lalolagi lenei ma le lalolagi a sau. E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu ia te i latou o e e lē o toeaina muamua, e faaauau pea i le tovine seia fetalai mai le fofoga o le Alii ia te i latou, ona e le’i oo mai lo latou taimi; e le’i mamā o latou ofu mai le toto o lenei tupulaga.

verses.en: Abide ye in the liberty wherewith ye are made free; entangle not yourselves in sin, but let your hands be clean, until the Lord comes.
verses.sm: Ia outou ola i le saolotoga ua faasaolotoina ai outou; aua tou te faalavelaveaina outou lava i le agasala, ae ia tausi o outou lima ia mamā, seia afio mai le Alii.

verses.en: For not many days hence and the earth shall tremble and reel to and fro as a drunken man; and the sun shall hide his face, and shall refuse to give light; and the moon shall be bathed in blood; and the stars shall become exceedingly angry, and shall cast themselves down as a fig that falleth from off a fig tree.
verses.sm: Auā ua lē toe tele ni aso mai le taimi nei, o le a luluina ma taumālua solo ai le eleele e pei o se tagata ’onā; ma o le a pupuni ai e le la lona pupula, ma o le a musu ai e tuu mai le malamalama; ma o le a gasetoto le masina; ma o le a feitai tele fetu, o le a latou faapa’u’ū ifo i latou lava i lalo e pei o se fua o se mati e pa’ū ifo mai se laau o le mati.

verses.en: And after your testimony cometh wrath and indignation upon the people.
verses.sm: Ma a mavae la outou molimau o le a oo mai le toasa ma le toatama’i i luga o tagata.

verses.en: For after your testimony cometh the testimony of earthquakes, that shall cause groanings in the midst of her, and men shall fall upon the ground and shall not be able to stand.
verses.sm: Auā a mavae la outou molimau o le a oo mai le molimau a mafui’e, lea o le a tupu mai ai le oi i totonu o ia, ma o le a pa’u’ū ifo tagata i luga o le eleele ma o le a lē mafai ona tutū.

verses.en: And also cometh the testimony of the voice of thunderings, and the voice of lightnings, and the voice of tempests, and the voice of the waves of the sea heaving themselves beyond their bounds.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai foi le molimau a le leo o faititili, ma le leo o uila, ma le leo o ta’uta’u, ma le leo o galu o le sami e fafati mai i latou lava e tia’ina o latou tuaoi.

w.en: And shall comes to pass also

verses.en: And all things shall be in commotion; and surely, men's hearts shall fail them; for fear shall come upon all people.
verses.sm: Ma o le a vāvāō mea uma; ma e moni lava, o le a pepē fatu o tagata; ona o le a oo mai le mata’u i luga o tagata uma.

verses.en: And angels shall fly through the midst of heaven, crying with a loud voice, sounding the trump of God, saying: Prepare ye, prepare ye, O inhabitants of the earth; for the judgment of our God is come. Behold, and lo, the Bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
verses.sm: Ma o le a felelei agelu i le taulotoa’iga o le lagi, ma alalaga atu i se leo tele, ma ili atu le pu a le Atua, e fai atu: Ia outou saunia ia, ia outou saunia ia, outou e ua nonofo i le lalolagi; ona ua oo mai le faamasinoga a lo tatou Atua. Faauta, ma tagai, ua afio mai le Faatoafaiavā; inā outou o atu ia e fetaia’i ma ia.

verses.en: And immediately there shall appear a great sign in heaven, and all people shall see it together.
verses.sm: Ma e lē pine ae o le a faailoa mai se faailoga tele i le lagi, ma o le a vaai faatasi i ai tagata uma.

verses.en: And another angel shall sound his trump, saying: That great church, the mother of abominations, that made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, that persecuteth the saints of God, that shed their blood—she who sitteth upon many waters, and upon the islands of the sea—behold, she is the tares of the earth; she is bound in bundles; her bands are made strong, no man can loose them; therefore, she is ready to be burned. And he shall sound his trump both long and loud, and all nations shall hear it.
verses.sm: Ma o le a ili e le tasi agelu lana pu, fai mai: O lena ekalesia tele, o le tinā o mea inosia, o lē na faia i atunuu uma ia feinu i le uaina o le toasa o lona faitaaga, o lē ua sauaina le au paia a le Atua, o lē ua faamasaaina o latou toto— o ia o lē ua nofo i luga o vai e tele, ma i luga o motu o le sami— faauta, o ia lea o titania o le lalolagi; ua fusifusia o ia i ni fusi, ua faamalosia ona nonoa, e leai se tagata e mafai ona tatalaina; o lea, ua saunia o ia e susunuina. Ma o le a ili umi ma leo tele e le agelu lana pu, ma o le a lagona e atunuu uma.

verses.en: And there shall be silence in heaven for the space of half an hour; and immediately after shall the curtain of heaven be unfolded, as a scroll is unfolded after it is rolled up, and the face of the Lord shall be unveiled;
verses.sm: Ma o le a i ai se taaligoligoa i le lagi mo le va o le afa itula; ma e lē pine lava ona mavae, ae o le a tatalaina le pupuni o le lagi, e pei ona tatalaina se tusitaai pe a uma ona taai, ma o le a afe ese le veli mai fofoga o le Alii;

verses.en: And the saints that are upon the earth, who are alive, shall be quickened and be caught up to meet him.
verses.sm: Ma o le au paia e i ai i luga o le lalolagi, o e o ola, o le a liua ma segia i luga e feitaia’i ma ia.

verses.en: And they who have slept in their graves shall come forth, for their graves shall be opened; and they also shall be caught up to meet him in the midst of the pillar of heaven—
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e na momoe i o latou tuugamau, o le a tutulai mai, ona o le a tatalaina o latou tuugamau; ma o le a segia foi i latou i luga e fetaia’i ma ia i le taulotoa’iga o le poutu o le lagi—

verses.en: They are Christ's, the first fruits, they who shall descend with him first, and they who are on the earth and in their graves, who are first caught up to meet him; and all this by the voice of the sounding of the trump of the angel of God.
verses.sm: O i latou ia o a Keriso, o faapolopolo muamua, o i latou ia o e o le a o ifo muamua faatasi ma ia, ma i latou o e o i luga o le lalolagi ma o i totonu o o latou tuugamau, o e e muamua ona segia i luga e feitaia’i ma ia; ma o lenei mea atoa e faia i le leo o le ili mai o le pu a le agelu a le Atua.

w.en: of the angel of the God,

verses.en: And after this another angel shall sound, which is the second trump; and then cometh the redemption of those who are Christ's at his coming; who have received their part in that prison which is prepared for them, that they might receive the gospel, and be judged according to men in the flesh.
verses.sm: Ma a mavae lea, o le a ili mai se tasi agelu, o le pu lona lua lea; ma ona oo mai ai lea o le togiolaina o i latou o e ua a Keriso i lona afio mai; o e ua latou maua la latou vaega i le falepuipui lena ua saunia mo i latou, ina ia mafai ona latou maua o le talalelei, ma faamasinoina e tusa ma tagata i la le tino.

verses.en: And again, another trump shall sound, which is the third trump; and then come the spirits of men who are to be judged, and are found under condemnation;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le a ili mai se tasi pu, o le pu lona tolu lea; ma ona o mai ai lea o agaga o tagata o e o le a faamasinoina, ma ua maua i lalo o le ta’usalaga;

verses.en: And these are the rest of the dead; and they live not again until the thousand years are ended, neither again, until the end of the earth.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou ia o totoe o e ua oti; ma e lē toe ola mai i latou seia uma le afe o tausaga, e lē toe ola mai lava, seia oo i le iuga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And another trump shall sound, which is the fourth trump, saying: There are found among those who are to remain until that great and last day, even the end, who shall remain filthy still.
verses.sm: Ma o le a ilia se tasi pu, o le pu lona fa lea, fai mai: Ua i ai i totonu o i latou o e ia tuu pea seia oo i lena aso tele ma le gataaga, o le iuga lea, o e o le a tumau pea i le eleelea.

verses.en: And another trump shall sound, which is the fifth trump, which is the fifth angel who committeth the everlasting gospel—flying through the midst of heaven, unto all nations, kindreds, tongues, and people;
verses.sm: Ma o le a ilia se tasi pu, o le pu lona lima lea, o le agelu lona lima lea o lē ua ia tuuina atu le talalelei tumau e faavavau— ua lele atu i le taulotoa’iga o le lagi, i atunuu uma, ituaiga, gagana, ma nuu;

verses.en: And this shall be the sound of his trump, saying to all people, both in heaven and in earth, and that are under the earth—for every ear shall hear it, and every knee shall bow, and every tongue shall confess, while they hear the sound of the trump, saying: Fear God, and give glory to him who sitteth upon the throne, forever and ever; for the hour of his judgment is come.
verses.sm: Ma o le leo lenei o lana pu, e fetalai atu i tagata uma, i e o i le lagi ma e o i le lalolagi, ma e o i lalo o le lalolagi— ona o le a lagona e taliga uma, ma o le a tootutuli tulivae uma, ma o le a ta’uta’u atu e laulaufaiva uma, a’o latou faalogoina le leo o le pu, ua fai mai: Ia matata’u i le Atua, ma avatu le mamalu ia te ia o lē o afio i luga o le nofoalii, e faavavau faavavau lava; ona ua oo mai le itula o lana faamasinoga.

verses.en: And again, another angel shall sound his trump, which is the sixth angel, saying: She is fallen who made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication; she is fallen, is fallen!
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le a ilia e se tasi agelu lana pu, o le agelu lona ono lea, ua fai mai: Ua pa’ū le fafine o lē na ia faia ia inu atunuu uma i le uaina o le toasa o lona faitaaga; ua pa’ū o ia, ua pa’ū lava!

verses.en: And again, another angel shall sound his trump, which is the seventh angel, saying: It is finished; it is finished! The Lamb of God hath overcome and trodden the wine-press alone, even the wine-press of the fierceness of the wrath of Almighty God.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le a ilia e se tasi agelu lana pu, o le agelu lona fitu lea, ua fetalai mai: Ua mae’a; ua mae’a! Ua manumalo le Tamai Mamoe a le Atua ma ua soli toatasi e ia le soligāvine, o le soligāvine lava lea o le mata’utia o le toasa o le Atua Malosi Aoao.

verses.en: And then shall the angels be crowned with the glory of his might, and the saints shall be filled with his glory, and receive their inheritance and be made equal with him.
verses.sm: Ma ona faapaleina ai lea o agelu i le mamalu o lona malosi, ma o le a faatumuina le au paia i lona mamalu, ma maua lo latou tofi ma faia i latou ia tutusa ma ia.

verses.en: And then shall the first angel again sound his trump in the ears of all living, and reveal the secret acts of men, and the mighty works of God in the first thousand years.
verses.sm: Ma ona toe ili lea e le agelu muamua lana pu i taliga o tagata ola uma, ma faaalia galuega lilo a tagata, ma galuega ofoofogia a le Atua i le uluai afe o tausaga.

verses.en: And then shall the second angel sound his trump, and reveal the secret acts of men, and the thoughts and intents of their hearts, and the mighty works of God in the second thousand years—
verses.sm: Ma ona ili ai lea e le agelu lona lua lana pu, ma faaalia galuega lilo a tagata, ma mafaufauga ma faamoemoega o o latou loto, ma galuega ofoofogia a le Atua i le afe lona lua o tausaga—

verses.en: And so on, until the seventh angel shall sound his trump; and he shall stand forth upon the land and upon the sea, and swear in the name of him who sitteth upon the throne, that there shall be time no longer; and Satan shall be bound, that old serpent, who is called the devil, and shall not be loosed for the space of a thousand years.
verses.sm: Ma faapea lava ona faasolo, seia oo ina ili e le agelu lona fitu lana pu; ma o le a tu atu o ia i luga o le laueleele ma luga o le sami, ma tauto atu i le suafa o ia o lē ua afio i luga o le nofoalii, ua lē toe i ai se taimi; ma o le a noatia Satani, le gata tuai lena, o lē ua ta’ua o le tiapolo, ma o le a lē tatalaina mo le va o se afe o tausaga.

verses.en: And then he shall be loosed for a little season, that he may gather together his armies.
verses.sm: Ma ona tatala ai lea o ia mo se vaitau itiiti, ina ia mafai ona faapotopoto faatasi e ia ana autau.

verses.en: And Michael, the seventh angel, even the archangel, shall gather together his armies, even the hosts of heaven.
verses.sm: Ma o Mekaeli, le agelu lona fitu, le agelu silisili lea, o le a faapotopoto faatasi e ia ana autau, o ’au lava ia o le lagi.

verses.en: And the devil shall gather together his armies; even the hosts of hell, and shall come up to battle against Michael and his armies.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapotopoto faatasi e le tiapolo ana autau; o ’au lava ia o seoli, ma o le a o mai i luga e tau faasaga ia Mekaeli ma ana autau.

verses.en: And then cometh the battle of the great God; and the devil and his armies shall be cast away into their own place, that they shall not have power over the saints any more at all.
verses.sm: Ma ona oo mai ai lea o le taua a le Atua silisili; ma o le a lafo ese le tiapolo ma ana autau i lo latou lava nofoaga, o le a latou lē toe maua se mana i luga o le au paia.

verses.en: For Michael shall fight their battles, and shall overcome him who seeketh the throne of him who sitteth upon the throne, even the Lamb.
verses.sm: Auā o le a tau e Mekaeli a latou taua, ma o le a manumalo ia te ia o lē ua saili i le nofoalii o ia o lē ua afio i luga o le nofoalii, o le Tamai Mamoe lava lea.

verses.en: This is the glory of God, and the sanctified; and they shall not any more see death.
verses.sm: O le mamalu lava lea o le Atua, ma e ua faapaiaina; ma o le a latou lē toe vaai i le oti.

verses.en: Therefore, verily I say unto you, my friends, call your solemn assembly, as I have commanded you.
verses.sm: O lea, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a’u uo, ia talo sa outou faapotopotoga paia, e pei ona Ou poloaiina ai outou.

verses.en: And as all have not faith, seek ye diligently and teach one another words of wisdom; yea, seek ye out of the best books words of wisdom; seek learning, even by study and also by faith.
verses.sm: Ma talu ona ua lē i ai i tagata uma le faatuatua, ia outou saili ma le filiga ma aoao atu e le tasi i le isi upu o le poto; ioe, ia outou saili mai totonu o tusi sili ona lelei upu o le poto; saili i le aoaoina, e ala lava lea i le suesue ma le faatuatua foi.

verses.en: Organize yourselves; prepare every needful thing; and establish a house, even a house of prayer, a house of fasting, a house of faith, a house of learning, a house of glory, a house of order, a house of God;
verses.sm: Ia outou faatulaga tatau outou lava; ia saunia mea manaomia uma; ma faatuina se fale, o se fale tatalo lea, o se fale o le anapogi, o se fale o le faatuatua, o se fale o le a’oa’oga, o se fale o le mamalu, o se fale maopoopo, o se fale o le Atua;

verses.en: That your incomings may be in the name of the Lord; that your outgoings may be in the name of the Lord; that all your salutations may be in the name of the Lord, with uplifted hands unto the Most High.
verses.sm: Ina ia faia a outou ulufale mai i le suafa o le Alii; ina ia faia a outou ulufafo atu i le suafa o le Alii; ina ia faia a outou feofoofoa’iga i le suafa o le Alii, ma lima ua sii atu i le Silisili Ese.

verses.en: Therefore, cease from all your light speeches, from all laughter, from all your lustful desires, from all your pride and light-mindedness, and from all your wicked doings.
verses.sm: O lea, ia taofi mai ia outou upu faatauvaa uma, mai toēēga uma, mai o outou manao tuinanau uma, mai lo outou faamaualuga ma manatu-māmā uma, ma mai ia outou amioleaga uma o fai.

verses.en: Appoint among yourselves a teacher, and let not all be spokesmen at once; but let one speak at a time and let all listen unto his sayings, that when all have spoken that all may be edified of all, and that every man may have an equal privilege.
verses.sm: Tofi se faiaoga i totonu o outou lava, ma ia lē tuu atu i tagata uma e tāutatala i le taimi e tasi; ae tuu atu i tagata e tautala taitoatasi mai ae tuu i isi tagata uma e faalogologo i ana upu, ina a uma ai ona tautala mai o tagata uma, o le a faapea ona mafai ona faagaeetia ai o tagata uma, ma ina ia mafai ona maua ai e tagata taitoatasi le avanoa tutusa.

verses.en: See that ye love one another; cease to be covetous; learn to impart one to another as the gospel requires.
verses.sm: Vaai ia outou alofa o le tasi i le isi; tuu le losilosivale; a’oa’o e fetufaai o le tasi ma le isi e pei ona manaomia i le talalelei.

verses.en: Cease to be idle; cease to be unclean; cease to find fault one with another; cease to sleep longer than is needful; retire to thy bed early, that ye may not be weary; arise early, that your bodies and your minds may be invigorated.
verses.sm: Tuu le faapaiē; tuu le lē mamā, tuu le fai pona o le tasi i le isi; tuu le moe umi nai lo le mea e tatau ai; vave momoe, ina ia outou lē vaivai; alapo a’e, ina ia olaola o outou tino ma o outou mafaufau.

verses.en: And above all things, clothe yourselves with the bond of charity, as with a mantle, which is the bond of perfectness and peace.
verses.sm: Ma silisili i luga o mea uma, ia outou faaoofu outou lava i le fusi o le alofa mama, e pei o se ofutalaloa, o le fusi lea o le atoatoa ma le filemu.

verses.en: Pray always, that ye may not faint, until I come. Behold, and lo, I will come quickly, and receive you unto myself. Amen.
verses.sm: Ia tatalo e lē aunoa, ina ia outou lē vaivai, seia Ou alu atu. Faauta, ma tagai, e vave ona Ou alu atu, ma ave outou mo a’u lava. Amene.

verses.en: And again, the order of the house prepared for the presidency of the school of the prophets, established for their instruction in all things that are expedient for them, even for all the officers of the church, or in other words, those who are called to the ministry in the church, beginning at the high priests, even down to the deacons—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le faatulagaga o le fale ua saunia mo le au peresitene o le a’oga a perofeta, ua faatuina mo lo latou a’oa’oina i mea uma e tatau ai mo i latou, e oo lava mo le au mautofi uma o le ekalesia, po o ua faapea, o i latou ia o e ua valaaulia i le auaunaga i le ekalesia, e amata mai i faitaulaga sili, e oo atu lava i lalo i tiakono—

verses.en: And this shall be the order of the house of the presidency of the school: He that is appointed to be president, or teacher, shall be found standing in his place, in the house which shall be prepared for him.
verses.sm: Ma o le faatulagaga lenei o le fale o le au peresitene o le a’oga: O ia o lē e tofia e avea ma peresitene, po o le faiaoga, ia tu i lona tulaga, i le fale o le a saunia mo ia.

verses.en: Therefore, he shall be first in the house of God, in a place that the congregation in the house may hear his words carefully and distinctly, not with loud speech.
verses.sm: O lea, ia muamua o ia i le maota o le Atua, i se mea e mafai ai e le faapotopotoga ona lagona lelei mai ma le manino ana upu, e lē o le leo tele.

verses.en: And when he cometh into the house of God, for he should be first in the house—behold, this is beautiful, that he may be an example—
verses.sm: Ma a sau o ia i le maota o le Atua, ona o ia e tatau ona muamua i totonu o le maota— faauta, ua matagofie lenei mea, ina ia avea o ia o se faataitaiga—

verses.en: Let him offer himself in prayer upon his knees before God, in token or remembrance of the everlasting covenant.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te ia e ofo atu o ia lava i le tatalo i luga o ona tulivae i luma o le Atua, i le faailoga po o le faatusa o le feagaiga tumau e faavavau.

verses.en: And when any shall come in after him, let the teacher arise, and, with uplifted hands to heaven, yea, even directly, salute his brother or brethren with these words:
verses.sm: Ma a i ai se tasi e sau i totonu mulimuli mai ia te ia, ia tuu atu i le faiaoga e tulai, ma, faatasi ma lima ua sii i luga i le lagi, ioe, faasasa’o lava, faafeiloa’i lona uso po o uso, i upu nei:

verses.en: Art thou a brother or brethren? I salute you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, in token or remembrance of the everlasting covenant, in which covenant I receive you to fellowship, in a determination that is fixed, immovable, and unchangeable, to be your friend and brother through the grace of God in the bonds of love, to walk in all the commandments of God blameless, in thanksgiving, forever and ever. Amen.
verses.sm: O oe ea o se uso po o ni uso? Ou te faafeiloa’i ia te oe i le suafa o le Alii o Iesu Keriso, i le faailoga po o le faatusa o le feagaiga tumau e faavavau, le feagaiga lea ou te talia ai oe i le usoga, i se tautinoga e tumau, e lē maluelue, ma lē masuia, e avea ma au uo ma ou uso e ala i le alofa tunoa o le Atua i fusi o le alofa, e savavali i poloaiga uma a le Atua ma le lē ponā, i le faafetai, e faavavau faavavau lava. Amene.

verses.en: And he that is found unworthy of this salutation shall not have place among you; for ye shall not suffer that mine house shall be polluted by him.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e maua ua lē agavaa i lenei faafeiloaiga ia lē i ai se nofoaga i totonu o outou; auā e le tatau ona outou faatagaina lo’u fale ia faaeleeleaina e ia.

verses.en: And he that cometh in and is faithful before me, and is a brother, or if they be brethren, they shall salute the president or teacher with uplifted hands to heaven, with this same prayer and covenant, or by saying Amen, in token of the same.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e sau i totonu ma ua faamaoni i o’u luma, ma o ia o se uso, po o i latou o ni uso, ia latou faafeiloa’i le peresitene po o le faiaoga i lima ua sisii i le lagi, faatasi ma lenei lava tatalo ma le feagaiga, po o le fai atu Amene, i le faailoga o lea lava tatalo ma le feagaiga.

verses.en: Behold, verily, I say unto you, this is an ensample unto you for a salutation to one another in the house of God, in the school of the prophets.
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o se faataitaiga lenei mo outou mo se faafeiloa’iga o le tasi i le isi i totonu o le maota o le Atua, i le a’oga a perofeta.

verses.en: And ye are called to do this by prayer and thanksgiving, as the Spirit shall give utterance in all your doings in the house of the Lord, in the school of the prophets, that it may become a sanctuary, a tabernacle of the Holy Spirit to your edification.
verses.sm: Ma ua valaauina outou e fai lenei mea i le tatalo ma le faafetai, e pei ona o le a fetalai atu ai le Agaga ia outou i mea uma e fai i totonu o le maota o le Alii, i le a’oga a perofeta, ina ia avea ma maluapapa, o se fale fetafa’i o le Agaga Paia mo lo outou faagaeetiaga.

verses.en: And ye shall not receive any among you into this school save he is clean from the blood of this generation;
verses.sm: Ma ia outou lē taliaina i lenei a’oga se tasi i totonu o outou vagana ai ua mamā o ia mai le toto o lenei tupulaga;

verses.en: And he shall be received by the ordinance of the washing of feet, for unto this end was the ordinance of the washing of feet instituted.
verses.sm: Ma ia taliaina o ia e ala i le sauniga o le mulumuluga o vae, ona o le faamoemoe lea na faatuina ai le sauniga o le mulumuluga o vae.

verses.en: And again, the ordinance of washing feet is to be administered by the president, or presiding elder of the church.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le sauniga o le mulumuluga o vae ia faia e le peresitene, po o le toeaina pulefaamalumalu o le ekalesia.

verses.en: It is to be commenced with prayer; and after partaking of bread and wine, he is to gird himself according to the pattern given in the thirteenth chapter of John's testimony concerning me. Amen.
verses.sm: Ia amata i le tatalo; ma a uma ona taumafa o le areto ma le uaina, ia faaofu e ia o ia lava e tusa ma le ala ua tuuina mai i le mataupu e sefulutolu o le molimau a Ioane e uiga ia te a’u. Amene.
